passed: Teacher/Student field-validation errors receive a generic error message, which renders in a focusable role=alert summary; dashboard.js moves focus to that summary.
The show/hide control is a native type=button, reachable by Tab and operable with Enter or Space without submitting the form.
Tab order follows the form: password field, show/hide button, then submit button; the control has a visible focus indicator.
The account form uses native controls with visible focus styles, and its layout collapses to one column at narrow viewport widths.
notes: Keyboard behavior was reviewed from source; automated Playwright scans could not run because Playwright is unavailable, and the protected account route could not be independently verified in an authenticated runtime session.
